findings.section: docs/41 §3 planning fingerprint/event transitions and §6 crash tests
findings.title: Agent output is fingerprint-bound after Registry execution
findings.evidence: planning_fingerprint excludes generated Agent output. Prepare returns say, Execute calls Registry, and only later bundle_ready binds final command fingerprint. Thus pre-bundle tool_result events are not cryptographically tied to the exact Agent output; a crash after a tool returns but before tool_result Sync also leaves no durable result event. No-replan prevents duplicate actions but does not prove what Agent decision was executed.
findings.required_change: After Prepare and before any Registry call, persist a plan_ready event containing HMAC of the final canonical command and explicit template/source/effect binding. Persist a tool_started event before each Registry call; then tool_result. On result-Sync failure recover as unknown and never reexecute. Add crash injection at each boundary, with no sensitive content in sidecar.

findings.section: docs/41 §3 sidecar schema and failure audit separation
findings.title: Failed-call sidecar omits trusted actor/scope/risk provenance
findings.evidence: Sidecar explicitly excludes Actor, TraceID, risk, and task ID. On failed calls there is no successful lifecycle receipt/DB audit to demonstrate teacher_agent/classroom_event authorization, tool scope, and low-risk classification. A command HMAC alone does not expose a verifiable role/scope audit context.
findings.required_change: Persist fixed non-PII provenance fields or keyed task/trace correlations derived only from the verified capability/Registry entry (actor_role, trigger, scope, risk, tool sequence/result class). Validate they cannot be planner/HTTP supplied and fail closed on mismatched role/scope/tool. Continue excluding raw args/content/panic data.
